title: Before They Can Solve: Predicting Post-Training Coding-Agent Performance from Base Models

paragraphs.en: How can we predict which base checkpoint is worth an expensive round of agentic post-training? End-to-end pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K tests whether successful behavior already appears in a base model’s distribution, but it is a poor fit for agentic coding: many base checkpoints cannot reliably produce the well-formed tool invocation required to complete a task end-to-end. Single-shot or short-horizon tasks avoid these tool-calling failures by collapsing a multi-step interaction into a fixed prompt and a single patch, but they sidestep the core capability we care about: maintaining coherent state over many tool-using steps as the repository evolves. To bridge this gap, we treat successful post-trained agent trajectories as a lookahead signal of base-model potential. Replaying each trajectory and rerunning tests after every code-changing step identifies the decisive step : the first step whose cumulative patch flips the repository from failing to passing, certifying that the recorded action solves the task given the prior context. Motivated by a coverage principle for agentic traces, we build three screens at this step that do not require a base checkpoint to drive the harness from a cold start: (i) Decisive-Action BPB (bits per byte) measures the probability mass on the certified action, (ii) Patch MCQ tests the checkpoint’s choice between that action and alternatives rejected by the same verifier, and (iii) prefix-conditioned pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K evaluates support for functionally-correct generations and credits any continuation that the tests accept. Across ten pairs of public base and post-trained models, all three screens rank the cohort in close agreement with post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{pass@}1 . As our methods need only a benchmark’s successful trajectories and its verifier, they can be applied to turn future agentic coding benchmarks into base-model evaluations.

paragraphs.en: Choosing a base checkpoint to post-train is a high-stakes decision made before its agentic capabilities can be fully realized. paragraphs.en: Existing evaluations fail to address this problem for opposite reasons. End-to-end agentic coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) are too demanding for base checkpoints: pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K remains near zero because untuned base models fail to operate tool-use harnesses (Appendix F ). Non-agentic coding benchmarks exercise isolated coding capabilities, but do not test sustained interaction with an evolving repository, and their correlation with post-trained agentic performance is highly inconsistent. Across ten pairs of open-source base models and their eventual post-trained checkpoints, Spearman ρ \rho with post-trained SWE-Bench Verified pass ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{pass@}1 ranges from 0.830 0.830 on RepoBench XFirst to − 0.394 -0.394 on HumanEval (Appendix E ). In short, current evaluations are either too agentic to run or not agentic enough to predict downstream performance .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we address the question at the heart of this problem: how can we evaluate agentic coding potential without requiring the base checkpoint to already behave like an agent? To answer this question, we build on the coverage principle: a promising base checkpoint should retain probability mass on behaviors that post-training may later select, rather than merely maximizing average correctness or conforming to today’s agent protocol ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) . Agentic trajectories from frontier models on existing agentic coding benchmarks are a natural source for such desirable behaviors; an important follow-up is therefore where in an agentic trajectory to probe that probability mass. We let the verifier of the original agentic coding task decide.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们探讨了该问题的核心问题：如何评估智能体编码潜力，而无需基础检查点已经表现出智能体的行为？ 为了回答这个问题，我们基于覆盖原则进行构建：一个有前景的基础检查点应当保留那些在后续训练后可能被选择的行为的概率质量，而不仅仅是最大化平均正确性或遵循当前的智能体协议（Chen et al., 2026；Yue et al., 2026）。 前沿模型在现有智能体编码基准测试中产生的智能体轨迹是这类理想行为的自然来源；因此，一个重要的后续问题是：在智能体轨迹的哪个位置去探测这种概率质量。 我们让原始智能体编码任务的验证器来决定。

paragraphs.en: For each step in a frontier post-trained LLM’s successful trajectory for an agentic coding task, we reconstruct the cumulative environment state and run the task’s tests at that state. This identifies the decisive step T ⋆ T^{\star} , i.e., the first step at which the verifier accepts the solution, as visualized in Figure 1 . The action taken at that step is our golden action : conditioned on the preceding trajectory, executing it resolves the task, while the state immediately before it does not. Unlike the benchmark’s gold patch (i.e., the human-written reference fix), this is an action produced by a real coding agent and certified by the same verifier that defines task success.
paragraphs.zh: 对于智能体编码任务中，一个经过前沿后训练的 LLM 成功轨迹中的每一步，我们都会重构累积的环境状态，并在此状态下运行任务的测试。 这可以确定决定性步骤 T ⋆ T^{\star}，即验证器首次接受解决方案的步骤，如图 1 所示。 在该步骤中采取的行动是我们的黄金行动：在给定先前轨迹的条件下，执行该行动即可解决任务，而紧在此之前状态则无法解决。 与基准测试中的黄金补丁（即人类编写的参考修复）不同，这是一个由真实编码智能体生成的行动，并由定义任务成功的同一验证器进行认证。

paragraphs.en: At T ⋆ T^{\star} , we construct three complementary probes as visualized in Figure 1 . Decisive-Action BPB asks an absolute question: how much probability mass does a checkpoint assign to the golden action? Patch MCQ asks a comparative question: can a checkpoint distinguish that action from plausible alternatives rejected by the verifier? Prefix-conditioned pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K asks a generative one: given the same trajectory prefix, can a checkpoint produce a continuation that passes the verifier? The three probes each answer a distinct, interpretable question about model behavior while holding the same agentic context and success criterion fixed. We validate them both by their aggregate correlation with post-trained agentic performance and by whether they correctly order individual checkpoint pairs by that same performance.

paragraphs.en: A framework for converting agentic coding benchmark into base-checkpoint evaluations. We start from successful trajectories on an agentic benchmark, replay them, and run the task’s tests after every code-changing step. The first step where tests pass is the decisive step: the action taken at that step becomes the golden action, and alternative edits attempted at the same point but rejected by the verifier become distractors. Each task yields (i) trajectory context until the decisive step (ii) a golden action (iii) distractors and (iv) an interactive, restorable environment state with an executable task verifier. The construction is a generic recipe rather than a fixed test set: any current or future agentic coding benchmark can be converted into a base-model evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 一种将智能体编码基准转化为基础检查点评估的框架。 我们从智能体基准中的成功轨迹出发，重演这些轨迹，并在每次代码修改步骤后运行任务的测试。 测试首次通过的步骤即为决定性步骤：该步骤中采取的行动成为黄金行动，而同一时刻尝试但被验证器拒绝的替代编辑则成为干扰项。 每个任务都会产生（i）直至决定性步骤的轨迹上下文（ii）一个黄金行动（iii）干扰项以及（iv）一个可交互、可恢复的环境状态和一个可执行的任务验证器。 这种构建方式是一种通用方法，而非固定的测试集：任何当前或未来的智能体编码基准都可以转化为基础模型评估。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end agentic evaluation. Long-horizon, end-to-end agentic evaluations place a model inside an interactive environment and score whether the resulting model–harness system completes a task. SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) provides human-validated repository issues with test-based grading. SWE-bench Multilingual ( Yang et al., 2026 ) extends that task format to nine languages across 41 repositories. SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) targets longer-horizon, enterprise-style tasks. Terminal-Bench ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) broadens the scope from repository issues to command-line workflows. DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) uses original, multilingual tasks with purpose-built verifiers. FrontierCode ( Lu et al., 2026 ) moves the bar from correctness to mergeability , grading maintainer-authored tasks against an ensemble of unit tests. Some base checkpoint evaluation work treats end-to-end pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K as a capability ceiling ( Yue et al., 2026 ) . However, these benchmarks are poorly suited to meaningfully evaluating base checkpoints that are usually too weak at such agentic capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端智能体评估。 长期、端到端的智能体评估将模型置于交互式环境中，并评分由此产生的模型–执行系统是否完成任务。 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez 等，2024；OpenAI，2024）提供经人类验证的仓库问题，并采用基于测试的评分方式。 SWE-bench Multilingual（Yang 等，2026）将该任务格式扩展至九种语言，涵盖 41 个仓库。 SWE-bench Pro（Deng 等，2025）针对更长周期、企业级任务。 Terminal-Bench（Merrill 等，2026）将评估范围从仓库问题扩展到命令行工作流程。 DeepSWE（Huang 等，2026）使用原创的多语言任务，并配备专门设计的验证器。 FrontierCode（Lu 等，2026）将评估标准从正确性提升至可合并性，通过维护者编写的任务与单元测试集进行评分。 部分基础检查点评估工作将端到端通过率 ​@​ K \mathrm{pass@}K 视为能力上限（Yue 等，2026）。 然而，这些基准测试并不适合对通常在这些智能体能力上过于薄弱的基础检查点进行有意义的评估。

paragraphs.en: Non-agentic code evaluation. Traditional code benchmarks isolate capabilities within bounded input–output tasks. HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) test function synthesis. EvalPlus ( Liu et al., 2023 ) provides more rigorous criteria for assessing the functional correctness of LLM-synthesized code. APPS ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) and DS-1000 ( Lai et al., 2023 ) scale to competition problems and realistic libraries. BigCodeBench ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) adds complex instructions and library use. LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) emphasizes contamination-resistant competitive programming with one-step repair. CRUXEval ( Gu et al., 2024 ) tests execution reasoning. RepoBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and CrossCodeEval ( Ding et al., 2023 ) add repository-level, cross-file context but retain a completion-style target. These benchmarks can be applied to base checkpoints, but do not test agentic behavior.

paragraphs.en: Base-checkpoint proxies for post-training potential. APTBench ( Qin et al., 2025 ) and RuDE ( Li et al., 2026 ) use answer discrimination to estimate base checkpoints’ downstream potential. RuDE contrasts answers labeled by model-judged rubric compliance; our agentic coding setting provides executable verifiers. APTBench’s SWE MCQs use reference-derived and LLM-extracted, rewritten, or generated answer choices, including gold patches paired with execution-filtered distractors. Our independent audit of 1,682 APTBench MCQs identifies questions whose designated correct option is incorrect or not uniquely correct (Appendix A ); Appendix B reproduces its reported correlations on our cohort. Such defects weaken the interpretation of MCQ accuracy as the ability to distinguish correct from incorrect answers, even when aggregate scores correlate with post-training performance. We therefore construct Patch MCQ at the decisive step: the golden action is verifier-certified, while distractors are alternative actions rejected by the same verifier. This grounds the score in a specific, interpretable criterion: whether a checkpoint can distinguish the golden action from rejected plausible alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 基础检查点代理模型用于评估训练后的潜力。 APTBench（Qin 等人，2025）和 RuDE（Li 等人，2026）通过答案判别法来估算基础检查点的下游任务潜力。 RuDE 对比由模型依据评分标准判断的答案；而我们的智能体编码设置则提供了可执行的验证器。 APTBench 的 SWE MCQ 题目使用参考答案衍生、经 LLM 提取、改写或生成的选项，包括标准修复方案以及与执行结果过滤后的干扰项。 我们对 1,682 道 APTBench MCQ 题目的独立审计发现，部分题目的指定正确选项是错误的或非唯一正确的（附录 A）；附录 B 复现了其在我们的数据集上报告的相关性。 此类缺陷削弱了将 MCQ 准确率解释为区分正确与错误答案的能力这一结论的可靠性，即便总分与训练后表现存在相关性。 因此，我们在关键步骤上构建了 Patch MCQ：标准操作由验证器认证，而干扰项则是被同一验证器拒绝的其他操作。 这将分数锚定在一个具体且可解释的标准上：即检查点能否区分标准操作与被拒绝的合理替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Base-model support and post-training potential. Base checkpoints can contain preference signal that their generations hide: pretrained models rank an answer with its true instruction far above a mismatched one even when their own samples are poor ( Hewitt et al., 2024 ) . Chen et al. (2026) define the “coverage” principle, where strong base models already assign high probability mass to high-quality responses. RLVR mainly sharpens solutions base models can already sample rather than creating new ones ( Yue et al., 2026 ) . Pushing further, Wu et al. (2025) find RLVR improves pass ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{pass@}1 , yet with larger sampling budgets it loses access to more correct solutions than it gains, compared with base checkpoints before RLVR. Together, these results suggest base-model mass bounds post-training gains—exactly the quantity our probes measure.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型的支持与训练后的潜力。 基础检查点可能包含其生成内容所隐藏的选择信号：即使自身样本质量不佳，预训练模型仍会将符合真实指令的答案的排名置于不匹配的答案之上（Hewitt 等，2024）。Chen 等 （2026）提出了“覆盖”原则，即强大的基础模型已经为高质量响应分配了较高的概率质量。 RLVR 主要优化的是基础模型已经能够采样的解决方案，而非创造新的解决方案（Yue 等，2026）。 进一步研究，Wu 等 （2025）发现 RLVR 提升了 pass ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{pass@}1 ，但与 RLVR 之前的基础检查点相比，在更大的采样预算下，它失去的正确答案数量比获得的更多。 综合来看，这些结果表明基础模型的质量上限限制了训练后的提升——而这正是我们的探针所测量的量。

paragraphs.en: Likelihood-based evaluation. Likelihood has been studied heavily by the LLM community. Huang et al. (2024) show bits per character on domain corpora is near-linear in downstream benchmark performance . In fact, per-domain loss correlated across public checkpoints has been shown to be strong enough to select pretraining data ( Thrush et al., 2025 ) . It is also smoother than task accuracy, giving a more usable development signal than discontinuous task scores ( Heineman et al., 2026 ) . Raw likelihood is strongly affected by sequence length, confounding comparisons unless scores are length-normalized ( Holtzman et al., 2021 ) . Bits per byte (BPB) is one normalization that keeps checkpoints with different tokenizers comparable ( Magnusson et al., 2024 ) . We adopt BPB when constructing our evaluation framework.
paragraphs.zh: 基于可能性的评估。可能性这一概念已受到大型语言模型（LLM）研究社区的广泛探讨。Huang等人（2024）的研究表明，在领域语料库中每字符的比特数与下游基准测试性能之间接近线性关系。事实上，已有研究表明，不同公开检查点在各个领域的损失值之间的相关性足够强，可用于选择预训练数据（Thrush等人，2025）。此外，可能性指标比任务准确率更为平滑，因此相较于不连续的任务得分，它能提供更实用的开发信号（Heineman等人，2026）。原始可能性值会受到序列长度的显著影响，除非对得分进行长度归一化处理，否则这将导致比较结果失真（Holtzman等人，2021）。每字节比特数（BPB）是一种归一化方法，它使得使用不同分词器的检查点之间具有可比性（Magnusson等人，2024）。在构建我们的评估框架时，我们采用了BPB这一指标。

paragraphs.en: Decisive-Action BPB alone cannot establish whether an action resolves a task: two actions can receive similar scores even when a single-character difference causes one to pass verification and the other to fail. Our patch-based multiple-choice probe (Patch MCQ) addresses this limitation through a discriminative k k -way choice, presenting the golden action alongside alternatives that fail verification when applied after the same trajectory prefix. The probe asks the checkpoint to select the action that resolves the task, rather than only measuring the likelihood of the golden action.

paragraphs.en: Decisive-Action BPB and Patch MCQ both score the base checkpoint’s distribution over actions that were previously generated, but neither tests whether the checkpoint can successfully generate resolving actions. However, on agentic coding tasks, end-to-end pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K for base models is typically zero even for very large K K , since success often requires successive tool calls and agentic interactions with environments, which are not achievable by base models before post-training. Prefix-conditioned pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K measures whether at least one of K K sampled continuations from the trajectory prefix P i , ≤ T i ⋆ − 1 P_{i,\leq T_{i}^{\star}-1} successfully resolves the task.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a framework for evaluating base checkpoints’ agentic coding potential before committing to expensive post-training. The framework uses successful agent trajectories to provide the context that base checkpoints cannot yet reliably produce themselves and the task’s verifier to identify the decisive step, the first step that resolves the task. Probing checkpoints at the decisive step lets us assess their agentic coding potential without requiring them to operate a tool-use harness across an entire trajectory. Using this framework, we build three complementary screens: Decisive-Action BPB, Patch MCQ, and Prefix-Conditioned pass ​ @ ​ K \mathrm{pass@}K . Across ten base checkpoints, all three produce rankings in close agreement with post-trained SWE-bench Verified performance. The framework thus extends existing and future agentic coding benchmarks into tools for base checkpoint selection before expensive post-training.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether APTBench’s ( Qin et al., 2025 ) SWE MCQs have a uniquely correct designated answer and incorrect distractors, we audited all 1,682 questions in four components: Fix Patch, Plan, Test Patch, and Handle Error. We developed a rubric with agent assistance and applied it through automated review, assessing whether the designated answer correctly addresses the stated question and whether another answer choice is also correct. The audit included code execution and inspection of the underlying repository where needed. table 4 reports the audit results: 727 questions (43.2%) were classified as Invalid, meaning that the rendered question does not support the designated answer choice as uniquely correct.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 APTBench（Qin 等人，2025）的 SWE MCQ 问题是否存在唯一正确的指定答案和错误的干扰选项，我们对四个组成部分中的全部 1,682 道问题进行了审核：修复补丁、规划、测试补丁和错误处理。 我们在智能体的协助下制定了一套评分标准，并通过自动化审查加以应用，以评估指定答案是否正确解决了所陈述的问题，以及是否存在其他同样正确的选项。 该审核在必要时包含了代码执行以及对底层仓库的检查。表 4 报告了审核结果：727 道问题（43.2%）被归类为无效，这意味着生成的问题无法支持指定答案为唯一正确选项。

paragraphs.en: The audit identifies failures of both answer correctness and uniqueness. For example, Handle Error MCQ #67 asks how SceneNN data was processed, but its designated correct option recommends reinstalling torch_scatter , which does not correctly answer the stated question. In Plan MCQ #66, answer choices A and C contain identical text, “I need to run the script again,” but only A is designated correct. This MCQ therefore accepts answer choice A as correct while rejecting identical answer choice C.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审核发现答案在正确性和唯一性方面均存在缺陷。 例如，Handle Error MCQ #67 的问题是关于 SceneNN 数据如何处理的，但其指定的正确选项建议重新安装 torch_scatter，这并未正确回答所提出的问题。 在 Plan MCQ #66 中，答案选项 A 和 C 包含完全相同的文本“我需要再次运行脚本”，但只有 A 被指定为正确答案。 因此，该 MCQ 接受答案选项 A 为正确，却拒绝了内容相同的选项 C。

paragraphs.en: These examples show that selecting the designated answer choice need not mean identifying a uniquely correct answer: scoring can reward an incorrect answer or reject an identical answer that was not designated correct. Such defects weaken the interpretation of MCQ accuracy as the ability to distinguish correct from incorrect answers, even when aggregate scores correlate with post-training performance, as our APTBench evaluation in appendix B illustrates. These findings motivate Patch MCQ’s stricter construction ( section 3.3 ): explicit validation of each answer choice. Patch MCQ requires the golden action to resolve the task and each distractor to fail the same verifier from the same environment state ( section 3.3 ), grounding its answer choices in observed task outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 这些例子表明，选择指定的答案选项并不一定意味着识别出唯一正确的答案：评分机制可能会奖励错误的答案，或者拒绝一个未被指定为正确的相同答案。 此类缺陷削弱了将多项选择题的准确性解释为区分正确与错误答案的能力，即使总分与训练后的表现相关，正如我们在附录 B 中介绍的 APTBench 评估所显示的那样。 这些发现促使 Patch MCQ 采用了更严格的构建方式（第 3.3 节）：对每个答案选项进行显式验证。 Patch MCQ 要求黄金动作能够解决任务，而每个干扰项则必须从相同的环境状态出发，在相同的验证器中失败（第 3.3 节），从而使其答案选项建立在可观察的任务结果之上。

sents.en: The design constraint throughout is that verifier executions, not forward passes, are the expensive resource: a single candidate step must be replayed into a repository and have the task’s own test suite run against it, so the pipeline is organized to bound how many times that happens per trajectory.

paragraphs.en: A recording proxy sits between the agent CLI and the model endpoint, tees every wire request and response into a local store tagged by (batch, instance), and a post-hoc pass groups those rows into per-step records. It also means the recorded step boundaries are the agent’s own, not a reconstruction of them.

paragraphs.en: Every instance runs in its own container built from the benchmark’s published task image, with the repository checked out and the interpreter environment the task ships. Before an episode the working tree is reset to the task’s base commit with git reset --hard followed by git clean -fd ; the -x flag is deliberately omitted, because these images keep compiled extensions and packaging metadata as git-ignored build artifacts, and deleting them leaves a tree that cannot import the package under test. The patch is extracted with git add -A and a binary diff against the base commit, so the same ignore rules keep those artifacts out of the extracted patch. Prompts carry the problem statement only; the benchmark’s hint fields are deliberately excluded as a leakage control.
paragraphs.zh: 每个实例都在其自身的容器中运行，该容器由基准测试发布的任务镜像构建而成，其中已检出仓库并配置了任务所附带的解释器环境。 在每个回合开始前，工作树会通过 git reset --hard 和 git clean -fd 命令重置为任务的基提交；特意省略了 -x 标志，因为这些镜像保留了已编译的扩展程序和打包元数据作为被 Git 忽略的构建产物，而删除它们会导致无法导入待测试的包。 补丁通过 git add -A 提取，并与基提交进行二进制差异比较，因此相同的忽略规则可确保这些构建产物不被包含在提取的补丁中。 提示仅包含问题描述；作为信息泄露控制措施，基准测试的提示字段被刻意排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3 is the only component that executes untrusted code. For a candidate step it replays the recorded steps into a fresh container, extracts the cumulative patch, and runs the benchmark’s own verifier, recording the replay driver, the patch content or hash, the verifier command and environment, the pass/fail outcome, and an explicit infrastructure-error status. That last field is load-bearing: a verifier that rejects a patch is a normal search observation, whereas a verifier that could not run at all must not be read as rejection, so the two are recorded separately and only the latter invalidates a trial. Replay is strict in one specific way – a replayed command that does not match the recorded one raises rather than falling through to live execution. Falling through would leave the conversation the candidate reads describing a filesystem that a different command sequence produced, which yields a wrong-but-plausible score rather than an obvious crash. When the candidate takes over, its k k rollouts are scored in k k separate harness runs, because the harness keys predictions by instance identifier and k k patches for one instance would otherwise collide.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 阶段是唯一执行不可信代码的组件。 对于某个候选步骤，它会将在记录中的步骤重新播放到一个全新的容器中，提取累积补丁，并运行基准测试自身的验证器，同时记录重新播放驱动程序、补丁内容或哈希值、验证器命令与环境、通过/失败结果，以及明确的基础设施错误状态。 最后一个字段至关重要：拒绝某个补丁的验证器属于正常的搜索观察结果，而完全无法运行的验证器则不能被视为拒绝，因此两者会被分开记录，且只有后者才会使一次尝试失效。 重新播放在一个特定方面是严格的——如果重新播放的命令与记录中的命令不匹配，系统会直接报错，而不是继续执行到实际运行阶段。 如果继续执行，候选智能体读取到的对话将描述一个由不同命令序列生成的文件系统，这会导致得到一个错误但看似合理的分数，而非明显的崩溃。 当候选智能体接管时，其 k 次展开将在 k 次独立的测试框架运行中分别评分，因为测试框架会根据实例标识符对预测进行区分，否则同一实例的 k 个补丁会发生冲突。

paragraphs.en: Both scoring paths are endpoint-bound rather than client-bound: raising client concurrency on a saturated endpoint changed static-scoring throughput not at all, while two hosts differed by more than an order of magnitude on identical work. Shared endpoints also impose a concurrency ceiling, and exceeding it fails in a way that is not self-announcing. Past the ceiling the retry budget exhausts, a rate-limited forward returns nothing, and the rollout falls back to a prefix-only patch that is indistinguishable from a legitimate failed attempt – a degraded window reads as a low score rather than as an error. We observed one candidate score zero under saturation and 0.347 on a clean re-run, with the size of the correction tracking each arm’s measured rate-limit fraction. Two safeguards follow: runs are capped below the measured ceiling, and empty predictions written during a degraded window are purged rather than resumed over, since resumption logic keyed on file existence would otherwise treat them as complete forever. Long prefixes are dropped when they exceed an endpoint’s context limit, and because the longest prefixes are also the most-explored instances, those drops are a selection effect and comparisons are made on the completed intersection ( appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 两种评分路径都受端点限制，而非客户端限制：在已饱和的端点上提高客户端并发性，对静态评分的吞吐量完全没有影响，而两台主机在处理相同任务时的表现差异超过一个数量级。 共享端点还会引入并发上限，一旦超出该上限，系统会以一种无法自我提示的方式失败。 超过上限后，重试配额将耗尽，速率受限的前进请求不会返回任何结果，部署过程会回退到仅包含前缀的补丁，这种状态与一次合法的失败尝试无法区分——降级窗口会被视为低分，而非错误。 我们在饱和状态下观察到某个候选评分为零，而在干净的重运行中为 0.347，修正幅度与每个分支测得的速率限制比例相对应。 因此采取两项保障措施：运行次数被限制在测得的上限以下，而降级窗口期间写入的空预测会被清除而非继续执行，否则基于文件存在性的恢复逻辑会永久将其视为已完成。 当长前缀超过端点的上下文限制时会被丢弃；由于最长的前缀同时也是探索最充分的实例，这种丢弃属于选择效应，因此比较是基于已完成的部分的交集进行的（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Section 1 argues that bounded code benchmarks – those a base checkpoint can complete without sustained interaction with an evolving repository – do not measure whether it can become a capable coding agent. Table 7 quantifies that claim on the ten-checkpoint cohort of table 6 by correlating each benchmark’s base-model score with the same two post-trained downstream targets used throughout. BigCodeBench ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ) is named in section 1 as a member of this family but is not among our measurements, so it does not appear here; the two LiveCodeBench variants and the two CRUXEval directions are reported separately because they score different abilities.

paragraphs.en: RepoBench XFirst is the strongest bounded baseline by rank agreement ( ρ = 0.830 \rho=0.830 ), which is the figure section 1 and section 5 quote as the comparison point for Decisive-Action BPB. CRUXEval-O follows and is genuinely informative ( r = 0.814 r=0.814 , ρ = 0.758 \rho=0.758 ): predicting the output of a program exercises reasoning about execution, which is closer to what resolving a repository issue demands than synthesizing a standalone function is. paragraphs.en: End-to-end evaluation cannot rank base checkpoints, and the one signal it gives points the wrong way. Five of the six checkpoints resolve no task at all, so the benchmark ties them at the floor and cannot order them. Only Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B-Base resolves any, at 20.2%, which ranks it first end to end even though its post-trained family is fourth of the six, behind both DeepSeek V4 models and Nemotron Ultra. End-to-end pass ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{pass@}1 therefore ties five of the six checkpoints at the floor, and its one non-zero score places a mid-ranked family first: it is not merely uninformative but, where it discriminates at all, misleading. The exception of Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B-Base more plausibly reflects its familiarity with agent-formatted interaction than coding ability.

paragraphs.en: Where the Terminal-Bench gap comes from. Two checkpoints account for most of the disagreement between the benchmarks. Kimi K2 ranks fourth on SWE-bench Verified but eighth on Terminal-Bench, and Gemma 4 26B ranks ninth and sixth. The probes side with the SWE view of both, placing Kimi K2 fifth or sixth and Gemma 4 26B eighth or ninth, which is what costs them agreement with Terminal-Bench. The shortfall is thus a property of how the two benchmarks rank these models rather than a failure of the probes on the SWE ranking they were built from. Capturing Terminal-Bench-specific standing would likely require trajectories from command-line tasks, and aggregating probes across trajectory sources from several task families is a natural way to do so.

paragraphs.en: For an assistant step at position i i , the prefix is the universal rendering of the tool definitions and messages strictly before i i , while the target is the same rendering applied to message i i alone. paragraphs.en: Table 12 isolates how much the joint read owes to rotation itself. Taking the answer from the first rotation alone, rather than aggregating all four, costs 0.039 accuracy averaged over the cohort, and the cost is uneven: it ranges from − 0.005 -0.005 on Nemotron Nano, the one checkpoint rotation does not help, to + 0.081 +0.081 on Hy3 Preview. paragraphs.en: The primer alone is not enough, and prefilling is what makes a base checkpoint usable in the harness at all. With only the primer, 47.9% of generations on one checkpoint continued it as prose rather than acting, and 56% of those fabricated a Tool Result: or User: turn: the checkpoint kept writing the transcript instead of acting in it. Adding the steer did not fix this, since 79% of the generations that still failed to parse simply echoed the steer back as another System: block. The fix is to append the opening of the action envelope after the primer, so that the checkpoint’s first sampled token already lands inside an open action and a prose continuation becomes ungrammatical; the fragment is prepended back onto the sample before parsing, so the parser sees a complete action. On eight DeepSWE prefixes with 48 generations per arm, prefilling raised the share of forwards emitting a parseable action from 27% to 50%, raised the share that edit the repository from 10% to 27%, and cut steer echoes from 19% to 8%. The envelope is wire-specific and must open exactly what the agent parses: for the function-calling agent on DeepSWE it is [{" , the start of the tool-call JSON array, and for the text-mode agent on SWE-bench Verified it is the opening of the fenced command block that agent reads. Stop sequences follow the wire in the same way: they are kept in text mode, where they are load-bearing, and disabled for the function-calling agent.

paragraphs.en: The completion is parsed for the checkpoint’s own action with no instruct model in the loop: nothing repairs malformed output, so what is scored is exactly what the base checkpoint wrote. A turn that cannot be parsed raises an error rather than returning an empty action, because the agent would read an empty action as the episode being finished, and the rollout would then end looking like a legitimate failed attempt rather than a formatting failure. Each forward is sampled at temperature 0.6 ( appendix D ) with a 1,024-token cap: at 512 tokens, 95% of generations hit the cap and were truncated mid-command, and raising it to 1,024 lifted the parse rate from 68% to 80%. Because prefilling forces the first token to open an action, it leaves the checkpoint no room to deliberate, so we also tested a two-step variant that samples a short plan before the action. It lowered the share of forwards emitting a parseable action from 56% to 38%, since the spliced plan gave the checkpoint more transcript to continue instead of acting; every reported run therefore samples each action directly, with no plan step, within the three-step forward budget.
paragraphs.zh: 该完成结果仅针对检查点自身的动作进行解析，循环中不包含任何指令模型：因此，格式错误的输出不会被修复，评分结果完全基于基础检查点所写的内容。 无法解析的回合会引发错误，而非返回空动作，因为智能体若读取到空动作，会误认为当前回合已结束；这样一来，展开过程看起来会像一次合法的失败尝试，而非格式错误。 每次前向传播均在温度 0.6（附录 D）下采样，并设置 1,024 个标记的上限：在 512 个标记时，95% 的生成结果触达上限并在命令中途被截断；将上限提升至 1,024 后，解析率从 68% 提高到了 80%。 由于预填充会强制首个标记开启一个动作，导致检查点没有空间进行思考，因此我们还测试了一种两步变体：在生成动作前先采样一个简短的计划。 这种变体使可解析动作的前向传播比例从 56% 下降到了 38%，因为拼接后的计划为检查点提供了更多可供延续的文本，而非直接执行动作；因此，所有报告的运行均在三步前向传播预算内直接采样每个动作，不包含任何计划步骤。

sents.en: It lowered the share of forwards emitting a parseable action from 56% to 38%, since the spliced plan gave the checkpoint more transcript to continue instead of acting; every reported run therefore samples each action directly, with no plan step, within the three-step forward budget.
sents.zh: 这种变体使可解析动作的前向传播比例从 56% 下降到了 38%，因为拼接后的计划为检查点提供了更多可供延续的文本，而非直接执行动作；因此，所有报告的运行均在三步前向传播预算内直接采样每个动作，不包含任何计划步骤。

paragraphs.en: The k k rollouts at one decisive step replay identical prefix steps, which on a 352-rollout measurement accounted for 48% of rollout wall time. Caching that work requires two artifacts, because a prefix is two kinds of state: a committed container image carries the filesystem the candidate edits, and an observation log carries the conversation it reads. Restoring only the image saves nothing, since a host-side agent rebuilds its message history by re-executing commands; restoring only the log is worse, because the candidate then edits a pristine tree while reading a history that says otherwise. On ten prefixes the cache reproduced byte-identical patches and cut prefix wall time by 96%, roughly 40% per arm over the full pool, at about 64 GB of images per 120 prefixes. Committing a container preserves the filesystem but drops running processes, so prefixes whose recorded commands leave a background service behind are detected by probing both containers and dropped from the cache, with the uncached path used as the fallback.
paragraphs.zh: 在某个决定性步骤中，k 次智能体展开会重演完全相同的初始步骤；在 352 次展开的测量中，这些步骤占用了展开总运行时间的 48%。 缓存这些工作需要两种数据产物，因为一个初始状态包含两种状态：已提交的容器镜像承载了候选编辑操作的文件系统，而观察日志则承载了它读取的对话记录。 仅恢复镜像并不能节省任何东西，因为主机端的智能体会通过重新执行命令来重建其消息历史；仅恢复日志的情况更糟，因为此时候选智能体在编辑一个全新的树结构时，却读取了一个显示相反内容的历史记录。 在十个初始状态中，缓存生成了字节级完全相同的补丁，并将初始状态的运行时间减少了 96%，即在整个池子中每个分支平均减少约 40%，每 120 个初始状态消耗约 64 GB 的镜像数据。 提交容器可以保留文件系统，但会丢弃正在运行的进程；因此，那些记录命令中遗留了后台服务的初始状态，会通过同时检查容器和日志被识别出来，并从缓存中移除，未缓存的路径则作为备用方案使用。

paragraphs.en: The k k rollouts for one instance are scored in k k separate harness runs, because the benchmark harness keys predictions by instance identifier and k k patches for one instance would otherwise collide in a single predictions file. Generation is endpoint-bound while the harness is CPU- and disk-bound, so the two are pipelined: one rollout index is generated while the previous index is scored in the background. paragraphs.zh: 对于单个实例的 k 次智能体部署，会在 k 次独立的测试运行中进行评分，因为基准测试框架会根据实例标识符对预测结果进行键值匹配，否则单个实例的 k 个补丁会在同一个预测文件中发生冲突。 生成过程受端点性能限制，而测试框架则受 CPU 和磁盘性能限制，因此两者采用流水线方式：在生成一个部署索引的同时，前一个索引正在后台进行评分。 在将其用于报告中的运行之前，我们验证了该流水线路径与串行路径在字节层面完全一致。
